title: Project Coordinator – Industrial Equipment (f/m/d)
description:
Our team delivers customised industrial equipment to customers across Europe and North America.

What you'll do
- Coordinate project schedules between engineering, procurement and assembly
- Track milestones, budgets and change requests
- Prepare weekly status updates for customers and the plant manager

What you bring
- Degree in mechanical or industrial engineering
- 3+ years in project coordination in machine or plant building
- Experience with SAP and MS Project
- English at C1 level (written and spoken), because the customer correspondence and status meetings are in English
